name: client-mosaic
purpose: The client mosaic: a framed bento grid of customer cells where a story cell carries a photograph, the client's mark, one line of its result and a "read the case study" link, and a mark cell carries only the client's linked logo on a chosen fill. The layout is derived from the data: the first story spans two columns and two rows, every other story one column and two rows, every mark one cell. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'client-mosaic', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `frame-box`, `bento-grid` and `mini-button`.
useWhen: On the home page, to show the best customer stories and a wall of marks in one band.
avoidWhen: For three equal story columns → use `client-mosaic-columns`.
For a plain wall with one quote → use `logo-wall-quote`.
related: bento-grid` — the grid the cells are laid in.
client-mosaic-columns` — the three-column sibling with brand-coloured faces.
bestPractices: Two stories and six marks fill the four-column grid exactly.
Pick `fill` and `logoTreatment` together: a `knockout` mark reads on `white` or `primary`, a `monochrome` one on `canvas` or `surface`.

props.name: linkLabel
props.doc: Label of the link under every story.

props.name: stories
props.doc: The story cells, in order; each is `{ logo, logoAlt, photo, text, href, fill?, logoTreatment? }`. The first spans two columns and two rows, the rest one column and two rows.

props.name: logos
props.doc: The mark cells, in order; each is `{ logo, logoAlt, href, fill?, logoTreatment? }` where `fill` is `'canvas'`, `'surface'`, `'white'` or `'primary'` and `logoTreatment` is `'monochrome'`, `'knockout'` or `'as-is'`.
